recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Grill the chicken breast until cooked through.
Toss spinach, avocado, and cherry tomatoes in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.benefits: High in protein and healthy fats, great for energy and muscle recovery.

recipes.name: Chia Pudding
instructions: Mix chia seeds, almond milk, and honey in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with fresh berries before serving.
recipes.benefits: Rich in omega-3 and fiber, supports digestion and mental focus.

recipes.name: Veggie Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a pan.
Add chopped vegetables and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes.
Add grated ginger and soy sauce, and cook for another 2 minutes.
recipes.benefits: Packed with vitamins and antioxidants, supports immune function.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Blend banana, oats, eggs, and cinnamon into a smooth batter.
Cook small portions on a non-stick pan until golden brown on both sides.
recipes.benefits: Rich in fiber and natural sugars, a great start to the day.

recipes.name: Baked Salmon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Place salmon on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and season with garlic and dill.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, squeeze lemon juice over before serving.
recipes.benefits: High in omega-3 fatty acids, supports heart and brain health.

recipes.name: Berry Blast Smoothie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy.
recipes.benefits: Rich in antioxidants and protein, great for energy and recovery.

recipes.name: Green Power Smoothie
instructions: Add spinach, apple, banana, lemon juice, and water to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve immediately for a refreshing boost.
recipes.benefits: Loaded with vitamins and fiber, supports digestion and detoxification.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Protein Smoothie
instructions: Blend banana, peanut butter, almond milk, protein powder, and cocoa powder until smooth.
Serve chilled for a post-workout snack.
recipes.benefits: High in protein and natural sugars, perfect for muscle recovery.

nutrition_tips.tip: Eating a variety of colors ensures you get a wide range of nutrients. Try to include at least 3 different colors in every meal.
Stay hydrated! Aim for 8 glasses of water a day, and add a slice of lemon or cucumber for flavor.
Healthy fats like avocado, nuts, and olive oil are essential for brain health and should be included in your diet.
Try to limit processed foods and focus on whole, natural ingredients for optimal health.
